architecture.path: one positive pole and one return pole

checks.name: assembly identity, fit, keying, polarity, retention
checks.acceptance: Exact mating assembly recorded; full seating/keying; no terminal back-out or damage; continuity proves intended positive/return. Use manufacturer pull/retention value if available; otherwise bind a declared prototype screening force before testing.

checks.name: four-wire harness/crimp/contact resistance
checks.acceptance: Complete source harness plus connector hot positive-plus-return loop <=4.0 mOhm; no intermittent or unexplained imbalance; segment records retained.

checks.name: 40 A continuous derating and thermal rise
checks.acceptance: 40.0 A continuous under declared installation; every point <= lower of manufacturer limit and 30 C rise; hot drop and protected bus remain within contract; no damage.

checks.name: 45 A / 100 ms bounded transient
checks.acceptance: Controlled measured 45.0 A pulse for 100 ms within instrument/control tolerance, no uncontrolled overshoot, arc, release, damage, or unsafe restart.

checks.name: source protection and first power
checks.acceptance: Staged current-limited bring-up follows PISXME-P24-V100-FIRST-POWER-20260917; polarity, reverse protection, fuse, OVP/UVLO, inrush, EN/PG/reset/inhibit and shutdown criteria observed.

checks.name: complete path resistance/drop closure
checks.acceptance: Complete source-to-J1 positive-plus-return extraction including connector/crimp/harness/protection/copper/vias/planes/J1 transition <=10.0 mOhm hot.

instrumentation: four-wire Kelvin resistance method or calibrated low-ohm meter
differential voltage measurement at source and J1 field
evidence_requirements: exact assembly BOM/lot and mating housing/contact
raw resistance, pull/fit, waveform, thermal and first-power files
